rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi/dvandva-style compound nara-nārī-nṛpa, subjects who become submissive
refers to the practitioner performing the mantra recitation described previously
predicate adjective indicating being under control or influence
optative expressing the result or potential outcome of the ritual
compound maraṇa-avadhi indicating the temporal limit of the effect

items.question: What power over men, women, and kings does this mantra recitation grant the practitioner, and for how long?
premises: The practitioner recites the mantra a thousand times while touching the prepared mixture.
Men, women, and kings become submissive to that practitioner.
This state of subjugation persists until death.
items.inference: Therefore, the prescribed mantra ritual grants the practitioner lifelong control over people, including rulers.
items.plain_english: Men, women, and kings shall be submissive to him until death.
